requirement.original: 为什么这一步就开始fetch image了？不应该present step之后才fetch吗！
requirement.clarified: Fix image fetching workflow order in /plan and /review commands. Images should be fetched AFTER user confirms day is perfect, not BEFORE presenting the day to user.
requirement.what: Reorder image fetching step in plan.md, review.md, and corresponding todo scripts
requirement.why: Current workflow fetches images before user review, wasting time if user makes changes. Correct order: present day → user confirms perfect → then fetch images.

included: Move Step 14a (plan.md) to AFTER user confirms day perfect in Step 15
Move Step 4a (review.md) to AFTER user confirms day perfect in Step 14
Update plan.py todo list to reflect new order
Update review.py todo list to reflect new order
Ensure Step 3a numbering in review.md matches the substep pattern

success_criteria: In plan.md Step 15 INNER loop, image fetching happens AFTER user chooses 'This day is perfect'
In review.md Step 14 INNER loop, image fetching happens AFTER user chooses 'This day is perfect'
plan.py todo list has 'Fetch images' AFTER 'Day-by-Day Refinement Loop'
review.py todo list has 'Fetch images' AFTER 'Present complete day review'
Step numbering remains consistent (no duplicate step numbers)
constraints: Must maintain existing Step 3a error handling logic (retry, review-fix, continue-without)
Must preserve state tracking variables (retry_count_per_day, days_missing_images)
Must keep atomic exit of INNER loop (set day_confirmed_perfect = true)
Cannot break nested loop pattern in Step 14/15

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Image fetching todo appears before day presentation in review.py (line 9), causing orchestrator to attempt fetching before user sees the day
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Commit 94bca5f added Step 14a/4a image fetching but placed it OUTSIDE the INNER loop, before user confirmation. Todo scripts were created to match this incorrect order.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 94bca5f - feat: Add progressive image fetching to plan and review commands
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Feature added image fetching per day to avoid waiting until final HTML generation, but didn't consider nested loop workflow where user may iterate multiple times on same day
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Fetching images before user confirms wastes time if user requests changes (images fetched, then day modified, then images need re-fetch). Correct pattern: confirm perfect → fetch once → advance to next day.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Introduced 2026-02-13, affects all /plan and /review executions since then
